mapper.select: SELECT o.ORDERID ,oi.productid ,p.categoryid ,p.pnm ,p.title ,DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.cont, 200, 1) as cont ,oi.qty ,oi.price ,oi.price * oi.qty subtot ,o.TOTPRICE ,o.USRNO ,u.usrnm ,o.RDATE FROM p_order o JOIN p_order_items oi ON o.orderid = oi.orderid JOIN products p ON p.productid = oi.productid JOIN USERS u ON u.USRNO = o.USRNO WHERE u.usrno = #{usrno}
